description:
Title: Car Service

The police has a new app to remind you of your car service.
The process is started after a successful service.
When a service is necessary, the system checks if your car is still registered.
If it is registered, you are notified.
If you do not go to the service, you are fined after 30 days.
At the car service facility the mechanic enters the problems of your car for reference.
While you wait (can take several days), you get status updates via email.
You can pay through the app, when the repair is done.
The mechanic enters that the repair was successful and you got your "Pickerl".
The mechanic enters the time for you next service.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_CarService" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/car-service">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ServiceCompleted" name="Successful service completed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ServiceReminder" name="Service reminder"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_CarArrives" name="Car arrives at facility"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_StatusUpdate" name="Repair status update"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RepairDone" name="Repair done"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_CarService">
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_PoliceApp" name="Police Reminder App" processRef="Proc_PoliceApp"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_CarOwner" name="Car Owner" processRef="Proc_CarOwner"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Facility" name="Car Service Facility" processRef="Proc_Facility"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ReminderToOwner" name="Service reminder" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Start_OwnerReminder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_CarArrivesToFacility" name="Car arrives" sourceRef="Task_HandOverCar" targetRef="Start_CarArrives"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_StatusUpdateToOwner" name="Repair status update" sourceRef="Task_SendStatusUpdate" targetRef="Event_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RepairDoneToOwner" name="Repair done" sourceRef="Task_NotifyRepairDone" targetRef="Event_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ServiceCompletedToApp" name="Successful service completed" sourceRef="End_ServiceCompleted" targetRef="Start_ServiceCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <!-- Police Reminder App -->
  <bpmn:process id="Proc_PoliceApp" name="Police Reminder App" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ServiceCompleted" name="Successful service completed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ServiceCompleted" messageRef="Msg_ServiceCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckRegistration" name="Check car registration"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Registered" name="Car still registered?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyOwner" name="Notify owner of service" messageRef="Msg_ServiceReminder"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_30Days" name="30 days elapsed">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_30Days">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P30D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FineDecision" name="Owner went to service?" default="Flow_App_VisitDone"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_IssueFine" name="Issue fine"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FineMerge" name="Fine decision merge"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotRegistered" name="Car not registered"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReminderEnded" name="Reminder process ended"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_1" sourceRef="Start_ServiceCompleted" targetRef="Task_CheckRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_Registered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_3" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="Task_NotifyOwner">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${carRegistered}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_4" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="End_NotRegistered">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!carRegistered}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_5" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Event_30Days"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_6" sourceRef="Event_30Days" targetRef="Gateway_FineDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_7" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_FineDecision" targetRef="Task_IssueFine">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!serviceVisited}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_VisitDone" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_FineDecision" targetRef="Gateway_FineMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_8" sourceRef="Task_IssueFine" targetRef="Gateway_FineMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_9" sourceRef="Gateway_FineMerge" targetRef="End_ReminderEnded"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <!-- Car Owner -->
  <bpmn:process id="Proc_CarOwner" name="Car Owner" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_OwnerReminder" name="Service reminder received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OwnerReminder" messageRef="Msg_ServiceReminder"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_BringCar" name="Bring car to service facility"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_HandOverCar" name="Hand over car to facility" messageRef="Msg_CarArrives"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WaitMerge" name="Waiting for repair"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitUpdates" name="Status update or repair done?"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_StatusUpdate" name="Status update received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_StatusUpdate" messageRef="Msg_StatusUpdate"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_RepairDone" name="Repair done notification received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_RepairDone" messageRef="Msg_RepairDone"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PayRepair" name="Pay repair through app"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Paid" name="Repair paid"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_1" sourceRef="Start_OwnerReminder" targetRef="Task_BringCar"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_2" sourceRef="Task_BringCar" targetRef="Task_HandOverCar"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_3" sourceRef="Task_HandOverCar" targetRef="Gateway_WaitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_4" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitMerge" targetRef="Gateway_WaitUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_5" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitUpdates" targetRef="Event_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_6" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitUpdates" targetRef="Event_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_7" sourceRef="Event_StatusUpdate" targetRef="Gateway_WaitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_8" sourceRef="Event_RepairDone" targetRef="Task_PayRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_9" sourceRef="Task_PayRepair" targetRef="End_Paid"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <!-- Car Service Facility -->
  <bpmn:process id="Proc_Facility" name="Car Service Facility" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CarArrives" name="Car arrives at facility">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CarArrives" messageRef="Msg_CarArrives"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RecordProblems" name="Enter car problems for reference"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepairMerge" name="Repair waiting merge"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_PerformRepairStep" name="Perform repair work"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepairDone" name="Repair finished?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendStatusUpdate" name="Send status update email" messageRef="Msg_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RecordSuccess" name="Record successful repair and issue Pickerl"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyRepairDone" name="Notify owner repair is done" messageRef="Msg_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RecordNextService" name="Record time of next service"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ServiceCompleted" name="Service completed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ServiceCompletedEnd" messageRef="Msg_ServiceCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fac_1" sourceRef="Start_CarArrives" targetRef="Task_RecordProblems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fac_2" sourceRef="Task_RecordProblems" targetRef="Gateway_RepairMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fac_3" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairMerge" targetRef="Task_PerformRepairStep"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fac_4" sourceRef="Task_PerformRepairStep" targetRef="Gateway_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fac_5" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairDone" targetRef="Task_RecordSuccess">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${repairFinished}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fac_6" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairDone" targetRef="Task_SendStatusUpdate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!repairFinished}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fac_7" sourceRef="Task_SendStatusUpdate" targetRef="Gateway_RepairMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fac_8" sourceRef="Task_RecordSuccess" targetRef="Task_NotifyRepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fac_9" sourceRef="Task_NotifyRepairDone" targetRef="Task_RecordNextService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fac_10" sourceRef="Task_RecordNextService" targetRef="End_ServiceCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
